title: SKY-LESS's Modpack
description: This is a clean aeronautics-focused modpack that you can use and add on to as you please!
body:
This modpack is a lightweight-ish aeronautics focused modpack. it's designed to be easy to pick up and play, and you can add on as much as you want. I mostly made this because a lot of people were asking for a modpack :D

# Addons Reccomended
These are some mods that don't fit the modpack, but are still cool! or they're hosted on curseforge so I couldn't include them.

- Create: Tracks
- Catalogue (better mod menu)
- No Man's Land (cool biomes)

## Main Create Features:
- Create
- Aeronautics
- Big Cannons
- Enchantment Industry
- Extra Gauges
- Vibrant Vaults

## Visuals:
- Better Explosions
- Better Tooltips
- Nice Zooming
- Particle Rain, Particle Effects, etc.
- Subtle Effects

## Performance:
- performs well at 4gb of allocated ram, may stutter occassionally at 2gb.
- Sodium, Lithium, Ixeris, C2ME, Server Core, etc.

## Sounds
- Sounds physics Remastered
- Extra and More Immersive Sounds

## Extras:
- Vanilla Backport (everything but spears + tiny takeover)

And tons more!!
